comment.text: The incubation temperature is given as "30 degrees" without a unit, and the Methods call the preparation a "cell-free extract" although centrifugation alone does not remove every cell. Please state the unit and call it a clarified lysate. Also say at which wavelength growth was followed.

requirements.text: state the unit of the incubation temperature
call the preparation a clarified lysate
say at which wavelength growth was followed

paragraphs: An invented strain was grown in shaken flasks at 30 degrees for 48 hours. Growth was followed by optical density.
Cells were collected by centrifugation at 8,000 g for 10 minutes, and the cell-free extract was kept on ice. The cell-free extract was used within two hours.
Optical density was read at 600 nm in a plate reader every 30 minutes.
The invented strain reached a plateau after 36 hours in every flask.

ledger.text: Write temperatures with the degree sign and C, for example 30 °C
Do not call the approach or the substrate novel
